text: The Forge of Odyn is a wing of Skyhold that contains Odyn's legendary forge. Also found here are a number of stone tablets detailing the saga of Odyn and the Valarjar, as well as several display plinths for artifacts. The forge itself is managed by Master Smith Helgar, and has been operating for longer than many races have existed.
__NOTOC__ Former Banshee Loyalists are Forsaken, goblins, and blood elves located in Orgrimmar after the War Campaign.
Forgemaster Han is a Rajani mogu repairer and quest giver working at an anvil in the Silent Sanctuary in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms. He is their sole blacksmith.
__NOTOC__ Forgelite Sophone is a kyrian located in Aspirant's Crucible in Bastion.
Forgehand Demikos was a steward located in Aspirant's Crucible in Bastion.

The Forge Defense Consoles are located in the Chamber of Prophecy in the Halls of Origination during The Halls of Origination. They control the Watcher Statues guarding the bridge, and must be turned off to allow safe passage.
Forgefiend's Fabricator drops from Kin'garoth in Antorus, the Burning Throne.
The Forgotten Vault is a lost vault located at the Abandoned Junkheap. It was discovered by members of the Alliance and Horde, which in turn helped them find Mechagon.
Formcrafter's Pants drop from Orgozoa in the Eternal Palace.
Forge of Origination Relay is located in the Chamber of Heart.
__NOTOC__ Forgotten Ghouls are ghouls located at the Forgotten Hill in Tol Barad Peninsula.
__NOTOC__ Forlorn Ruins is a set of ruins taken over by the Gob Squad in Nazmir.
Forgehand Simo is a steward located at the Aspirant's Rest in Bastion.
The Forge of the Zephyr is located northeast of the Temple of Courage in Bastion.
Forgefire Engineers are stewards located at Forgefire Outpost in Bastion.
The Forgotten Forgehammer is located near the entrance in the Necrotic Wake.

Forgotten Village is a bonus objective offered to players in the vicinity of Dredhollow after completing the breadcrumb quest Dredhollow (quest) during the Revendreth storyline. Players will have ample opportunity to kill targets on the campaign quests Breaking the Hopebreakers, They Won't Know What Hit Them, and Rebel Reinforcements.
__NOTOC__ The Forgotten Chest is a chest found in Stormsong Valley.
The Forgotten Smuggler's Stash is a chest found in Tiragarde Sound.
Forge Keepers are mawsworn located in the Soulforges in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
__NOTOC__ Forgy is a dredger located in Darkhaven in Revendreth.
Forgemaster Madalav is a venthyr located at Dominance Keep in Revendreth. He can be summoned by members of the Venthyr Covenant after activating the Dominance Keep Anima Conductor.
Forgemaster's Crates are looted from Stone Legion Supplies and Bleakwood Chests in Revendreth.
Forgotten Dream Vials are looted from Reliquaries of Remembrance in Revendreth.
The Forgemaster's Many-Fold Rapier drops from Forgemaster Madalav at Dominance Keep in Revendreth.
Forgotten Weapons are found in the Spearhead in Maldraxxus. Foe Cleaver can also be looted from one of these.
Forgefire Outpost is located next to Nemea's Retreat on a hill northeast of Hero's Rest in Bastion. It is the workshop of Pelodis. A Discarded Centurion Core can be found here.
Forgotten Pursuer's Cowl is a quest reward from Maw Walker (quest).
Forgehand Tools are looted from Baedos' Regurgitated Treasure and Gilded Chests in Bastion. They can also be looted from Tribute of the Ascended.
Forgehand's Sabatons are a possible reward from many rare adventures. They are also looted from Tribute of the Paragon.
Forgehand's Legguards are a possible quest reward from The Secret Ingredient as well as many rare adventures. They are also looted from Tribute of the Paragon.
Forgotten Sweetcheese is found at the Cliffs of Respite in Bastion.
The Forgotten Shard of the Cipher is found in the Corrupted Ridge in Tanaan Jungle.
Forgotten Memorandums are found in and around the Walk of Recollection of Bastion.
Forges of Bonds are found in the sanctuary of all the covenants in the Shadowlands. This device allows for the use of Soulbinding. It is also here that conduits can be applied.

Forlorn Respite is a cave found at in the Planes of Torment in the Maw. The entrance is guarded by two Knights of the Ebon Blade during the intro quest line. In The Rift, the cave is known as the Hollow of the Insolent.

The Forest Ward, wholly composed by the Banewood, is one of the seven district wards of Revendreth and surrounded by tall walls. The Ember and Castle Wards are found to the north, while its eastern border is made by the Wildwall, with the Village Ward found on the other side. A small section of the Endmire runs through it. The Ward is ruled by the Harvester of Dread, currently The Fearstalker. Here is where the sacred tradition of the Penitent Hunt is held, also referred to as the Fearstalk. The former Scarlet Crusade member Houndmaster Loksey is one of the souls found here, as a prey of the Penitent Hunt.
Forgehand Parkeris is a steward located at the Aspirant's Rest in Bastion. He is found working on a Centurion Goliath.
Forgemaster Teo is a Maldraxxi gladiator located at the House of the Chosen in Maldraxxus.
Forgemaster Ingo is a Maldraxxi gladiator located at the House of the Chosen in Maldraxxus.
The forgelites are the crafters of Bastion. The highest-ranking one is titled Forgelite Prime, of which there have been only two in existence.
Forgehand Skafa is a steward located at Sagehaven in Bastion.
Forgehand Meka is a steward located at the Terrace of the Collectors in Bastion.
Forgelite Hephaesius is an Ascended kyrian located in the Seat of Eternal Hymns in Bastion.
Forgelite Neptira is an Ascended kyrian located in the Sanctum of Binding in Bastion.
Forgehand Phillo is a steward located in the Sanctum of Binding in Bastion.
Forged through Conquest: Shadowlands Season 1 is a player vs. player achievement earned by gaining 5000 Conquest during Shadowlands Season 1.
The Forgotten Forge is an ancient runeforge located in a cave within the Iron Trench. The Necrolords loyal to Draka are using it to forge their weapons.
The Forgotten Wounds is an area to the northeast of the Theater of Pain.
Forgelite Selene is a kyrian quest giver located in the Eternal Forge in Bastion.
Formal Fiend is a stone fiend located in Sinfall and the Ember Court.
Forged Oxxein Whetstones are looted from Bonebound Chest in Maldraxxus.
Forgotten Summoner's Shoulderpads is dropped by Nirvaska the Summoner at Bleak Redoubt in Maldraxxus.
Forlorn Loa-Binder Shoulders are an Isle of Thunder world drop.

The Forgotten Passageway is accessed from the Crimson Assembly Hall in Mogu'shan Palace. It leads to the Vault of Kings Past and, during The Engine of Nalak'sha, to The Repository in the Mogu'shan Vaults.
Forlorn Prisoner's Strap drops from mobs in the Sanctum of Domination.
Forgotten Shade's Shawl drops from Lumisende, Naelcrotix, Zograthos and Dathlane the Herald in The Maw.
The Forgotten Conservatory Helm is looted from Ancient Eredar Caches in Eredath.
The Forgotten Conservatory Leggings are looted from Ancient Eredar Caches in Eredath.
The Forgotten Conservatory Amice is looted from Ancient Eredar Caches in Eredath.
Forgotten Conservatory Robes are looted from Ancient Eredar Caches in Eredath.
Forgotten Emotions are tiny manifestations located at the Crypt of the Forgotten in Revendreth.

The Forgotten Soul is a soul held within a Catacombs Cage on the upper level of the Catacombs of Regret. It offers the quest Watcher Emil (quest) in case you dropped it or forgot to pick it up from the Curator.
The Forgotten Caves are a cave system in Gorgrond. The entrance is found just north of the Ruins of the First Bastion. The caves are full of spiders and pale orcs.
Several Forge Materials chests can be found in a small building at the Eternal Forge workshop. A Storage Warden is in the building with them, though it's initially inactive.

The Forge of Afterlives is a massive structure floating at the center of Zereth Mortis. As the name implies, it is responsible for creating new realms of the Shadowlands. When Maw Walkers arrive to Zereth Mortis, the Forge is in the process of putting together one such new afterlife.
Forgotten Gloves are looted from Greater Cache of Treasures and Cache of Treasures.
Forgotten Britches are looted from Greater Cache of Treasures and Cache of Treasures.
Forgotten Boots are looted from Greater Cache of Treasures and Cache of Treasures.
__NOTOC__ Forgotten Geomentals are geomentals located in the Untamed Verdure in Zereth Mortis.
The Forgotten Translocator is located next to the Fallen Vault down the eastern side of the Antecedent Isle in Zereth Mortis. It provides a safe way back up.

Several Forgotten Chambers are hidden beneath the Sanctuary of the Mad in Revendreth. They can only be accessed by repairing Broken Mirrors, which become available after the Venthyr Transport Network is upgraded to rank 3. The initial quest, Repair and Restore, involves entering a Forgotten Chamber that sits empty aside from a Battered Chest. Each chamber entered afterward contains a Forgotten Chest and one of the following types of enemies or obstacles: *A Dread Spinner and several Dreadspinner Eggs, which release Dread Spiderlings when touched *Bonebind Traps, which bring nearby Decaying Skeletons to life when stepped on *Two Ancient Tomes *Two Living Blades *Edvard *Eileen *An elite

__NOTOC__ Forgotten Mementos is a treasure found inside the Etheric Vault at the House of Constructs in Maldraxxus. To open the Vault Portcullis, run into the room to the left and find the chain to pull in order to release the portcullis.
Forgotten Venthyr Winged Kris is looted from Forgotten Chests in Revendreth.
The Forgotten Roost was a planned subzone in the Spires of Arak.
Forked Blade of Fortitude is sold by the following vendors in Bastion for 1 Abominable Anima Spherule: *Kelli Hoo *Alisius *Battlemaster Endios *Provisioner Prothos
__NOTOC__ Forge Defense Nodes are progenitor geodes located in Provis Fauna in Zereth Mortis. Occassionally, they will turn hostile, when attempting to tune them.
__NOTOC__ Forgotten Treasure Vaults are found throughout Zereth Mortis.
__NOTOC__ Forgotten Caretakers are automa located in Blooming Foundry in Zereth Mortis.
The Forgiveness Focus is found at Arkelios' Solace in Ardenweald.
__NOTOC__ Forgehand Veris is a Maldraxxi skeleton located in the House of Rituals in Maldraxxus.
Forgemaster's Grips drops from Forgemaster Gorek in Neltharus.
Forgotten Jewelry Box located at Nelthazan Ruins in the Ohn'ahran Plains. The Fragmented Key is found along with the box.

Forgetful Apprentice's Tome is located on a table at Algeth'ar Academy in Thaldraszus. An additional tome is looted from the Curious Glyph treasure. Only scribes with 25 points in Dragon Isles inscription may interact with them.
Forgelite Filter is a soulbind trait granted by Forgelite Prime Mikanikos. It is exclusive with Charged Additive.
Forgeborne Reveries is a soulbind trait granted by Bonesmith Heirmir.
The Forgotten Creation is an arcane elemental located at the Azure Archives in the Azure Span.
Forkriver Guards are centaur located at Forkriver Crossing in the Ohn'ahran Plains.

Forgotten Sack is located in Thornmire in Tanaan Jungle, next to the skeleton of a dead orc adventurer holding a Broken S.E.L.F.I.E. Camera on a stick. The sack's contents reveal that the adventurer sneaked into Tanaan with the intent of farming ravager hides before returning to Ashran, only to realize that they'd forgotten to bring their :hearthstone, leaving them to be eaten by ravagers. __NOTOC__
Forgemaster Bazentus is a black drakonid located in the Obsidian Bulwark in the Waking Shores.
Forkriver Traders are tuskarr, centaur, and drakonid located in the Ohn'ahran Plains and Valdrakken.
Forgotten Arcane Tome is looted from the Forgotton Arcane Tome in a building in the Azure Archives in the Azure Span. Only enchanters with 25 points in Dragon Isles enchanting may interact with it.
__NOTOC__ Forgotten Gryphon is a gryphon ghost located on a rise southwest of the Dragonscale Basecamp in the Waking Shores.
The Forgotten Statue is located in Zskera Vaults in the Forbidden Reach.
The Forgotten Dragon Treasure is found beneath a ruined tower in the Mirror of the Sky in the Ohn'ahran Plains. It is opened with the Everliving Wooden Key.
Forge and Befuddle is a profession achievement earned by delivering Forged Documents to the following gullible individuals.

Forsaken Plaguebringer are Forsaken plaguebringers that spray aerosol plague over Halgrind near New Agamand.

Forsaken Deckhands are members of the crews of The Windrunner, The Oblivion and The Dark Defiance. These people however are losing a battle with the Alliance's North Fleet Marines, who are presumably angry with the deaths of some crew members at the larger fleet of ships to the South. Although having nearly three times the health of the intruders, they seem to be considerably weaker as they are dispatched by the marins with relative ease. There is also another group of deckhands at an unknown boat further to the South slain by the Kvaldir searching for a lost artifact, ironically stolen from another boat.
Forsaken Prisoners are Forsaken located in New Hearthglen in Dragonblight. They are being executed by an Onslaught Executioner.
Forsaken Crossbowmen are level 68 - 69 Forsaken guards located at Vengeance Landing in the contested territory of the Howling Fjord.
The Formula: Enchant Weapon - Blade Ward drops from Ulduar bosses.
The Formula: Enchant Cloak - Superior Arcane Resistance teaches players Enchant Cloak - Superior Arcane Resistance.
Forsaken Chemists are a group of chemists in Agmar's Hammer in the Dragonblight. They are under the command of Grand Apothecary Doctor Sintar Malefious.
__NOTOC__ Forsaken Invaders are Forsaken during the worgen starting experience in Duskhaven and Northern Headlands in Gilneas.
The Forsaken Bodyguards are four Forsaken warriors who protect the Forsaken Courier sent by Apothecary Jorell at the Go'Shek Farm in the Arathi Highlands to Tarren Mill in the Hillsbrad Foothills.
Formula: Enchant Bracers - Major Stamina teaches Enchant Bracers - Major Stamina.

The Forsaken Front is an outpost and front lines to the Battlefront in southern Silverpine Forest. It's here Lady Sylvanas commands the attack on the Gilneas Liberation Front and where she had Lord Godfrey, Walden, and Baron Ashbury raised into her service.
__NOTOC__ Forsaken Herbalists are Forsaken found at Bathran's Haunt in northwestern Ashenvale.
Forsaken Camp "Supplies" are found around the Western Strand in the Hillsbrad Foothills for the quest Thieving Little Monsters!.
Forsaken Insignias are looted from Veteran Forsaken Trooper corpses in Olsen's Farthing in the Silverpine Forest.
This recipe is required by Enchanters to create high level Cataclysm enchantments.

Forsaken Apothecaries are Forsaken found in the Ruins of Lordaeron in Tirisfal Glades and throughout Silverpine Forest in varying numbers depending on which stage of the phasing one is in. They can initially be seen performing various tasks such as preparing plague wagons on the road between Tirisfal Glades and Forsaken High Command. Later, they appear at the Forsaken Front. Finally, they, along with most other NPCs in the zone, can be seen fighting during the final confrontation for control of Silverpine. They also appear in the Ruins of Gilneas.

Formula: Enchant Bracer - Agility teaches Agility (bracers enchant).
__NOTOC__ Forsaken Delegation Deathguards are Forsaken Deathguards found within Grommash Hold, standing alongside Dark Cleric Cecille, their blood elven counterparts just opposite them.
Forsaken Machinists are the pilots of the that have rolled onto Duskmist Shore in Gilneas, laying siege to the Hammond and Allen Farmsteads.

Forsaken Footsoldiers are the ground forces of the Forsaken army attacking the Hammond and Allen Farmsteads in Gilneas. The corn fields of the Hammond Farmstead provide excellent cover for their approach.
Forsaken Looters are level 13 - 14 Forsaken found at the Tower of Althalaxx in Darkshore. They search the corpses of Dark Strand Victims commanded by Teegan Holloway.
Formula: Enchant Weapon - Dancing Steel is a Shado-Pan reputation reward, sold for from at the Shado-Pan Garrison in the Townlong Steppes. It requires reputation to purchase.
Formulaic Cloak is a quest reward from Recipe for Disaster (Horde) in the Cape of Stranglethorn.
Forsaken Blightspreaders are mad scientists in Shadowfang Keep.

Foror's Fabled Steed is an unobtainable mount that summons a rideable chromatic drake. This mount exists as the Fabled Steed in . Its name is part of an elite caste of Game Master-only items, including Foror's Wipe Neutralizer and Martin Fury; in the case of this mount, it bears the name of Foror, the character of former Blizzard developer Alex Afrasiabi. Chromatic drakes did not become available as mounts for players until patch 4.3.0 with Experiment 12-B.
Forsaken Brains are racial PvP tokens used for the quest Forsaken Brains (quest) in order to receive a Dented Ashmaul Strongbox.
The Formidable Ring can be found inside Greater Bounty Spoils.
Formless Nightmare is a Voidlord located at the Pillars of Fate in Spires of Arak.
Formula: Tome of Illusions: Secrets of the Shado-Pan is sold by at the Shado-Pan Garrison in Townlong Steppes for . You must also be with the Shado-Pan.

Forsaken Foothold is a small camp found overlooking the Cove of Nashal in Stormheim.
Forsaken Frostflingers are friendly Forsaken frost mages that are at the Legion Invasion locations. Once saved, they can help the adventurers. They can only be saved by Horde adventurers.
Forsaken Engineers are friendly Forsaken engineers that are at the Legion Invasion locations. They are often found working on Forsaken catapults at Forsaken military camps.
Forsaken Bat-Riders are Forsaken riding giant bats called Forsaken Dreadwings in Stormheim. During the Legion Invasions, a contingent of them was sent to defend Tarren Mill in Hillsbrad Foothills.

Forsaken Captives are level 100 Forsaken found in Legion cages at the Sludge Fields of the Hillsbrad Foothills during the Demon Invasions. Saving them would improve the score of defense against the Legion. They can only be rescued by Horde adventurers.
Forsaken Deathstalkers are Forsaken rogues located at the Cove of Nashal attacking the Alliance and later further inland of Stormheim. They also appeared in the Battle for Darkshore.
Forsaken Archers are Forsaken located at the Warden Towers on the Broken Isles.
Forsaken Befoulers are Forsaken located at the Warden Towers on the Broken Isles.
__NOTOC__ Forsaken Bishops are Forsaken located at the Warden Towers in the Broken Isles.
Forsaken Coldwitches are Forsaken located at the Warden Towers in the Broken Isles.
__NOTOC__ Forsaken Dark Rangers are Darkfallen dark rangers located at the Warden Towers in the Broken Isles.
Forsaken Deathwarders are Forsaken located at the Warden Towers on the Broken Isles.
__NOTOC__ Forsaken Deceivers are Forsaken located at the Warden Towers on the Broken Isles.
Forsaken Defenders are Forsaken located at the Warden Towers on the Broken Isles.

Forsaken Dreadwings are bats that accompanied Warchief Sylvanas Windrunner and her fleet from Bladefist Bay in Durotar to Stormheim through the Cove of Nashal. They were ridden by Forsaken Bat-Riders. Their spit is plagued.
Forsaken Crewmen are Forsaken located in the Cove of Nashal of Stormheim.

Forsaken Deathguards are Forsaken who participated the Legion Invasions. They later traveled to Orgrimmar when Warchief Vol'jin died. They later appeared during the fight against the Alliance at the Cove of Nashal. Then they moved inland.
Forsaken Alchemists are Forsaken located in Deliverance Point on the Broken Shore standing next to Apothecary Keever and operating on Captured Wyrmtongues.
Forsaken Battle Plans is an object located at Bronzeleaf Thicket in Stormheim. It's a map that points to strategic Forsaken locations around Greywatch.
Fors Aitken is a Forsaken located at the Great Seal in Dazar'alor.
Forsaken Outriders are Forsaken located at the Writhing Haunt in Western Plaguelands. They are battling Provincial Settlers over control of the lands.
Formula: Enchant Gloves - Herbalism is a zone drop in Ashenvale.

Forsaken Marksmen are Forsaken located at the Dranosh'ar Blockade alongside other Horde soldiers shortly before the Burning of Teldrassil. Other marksmen are seen running from Orgrimmar's gates to report to Holgar Stormaxe, then continuing to the end of the Blockade to report to the Horde Warbringer who sort them into divisions that stand in front of Skull Rock.
The Formidable Choker can be obtained from Greater Bounty Spoils.
Forsaken Blight Throwers are Forsaken catapults located in the Ruins of Lordaeron during the Battle for Lordaeron.
Forsaken Deadshots are Forsaken located in Darkshore. Some of them are dead at Bashal'Aran. They also appear during the Battle for Darkshore.
Forsaken Prankster was a Forsaken that disguised himself as Innocuous Townsman using Human Male Mask during the Hallow's End and appeared in Southshore inn in Hillsbrad Foothills.
Formula: Enchanted Tiki Mask teaches enchanters to make Enchanted Tiki Mask.
Forsaken Laborers are Forsaken located in Lor'danel Landing in Darkshore. They are unloading boxes from Supply Kodos. They also appear during the Battle for Darkshore.
Forsaken Plague Wagons is a wagon located in Lor'danel Landing in Darkshore. More are present during the Battle for Darkshore.
Forsaken Lancers are Forsaken located in Lor'danel Landing in Darkshore. They are also present during the Battle for Darkshore.
Forsaken Horses are skeletal horses located in the Stables of Arathi Basin.
The Formidable Yellow Belt is sold by Master Cannon at the Peak of Serenity in Kun-Lai Summit.
Forsaken Blade is sold by Initiate Claget in Icecrown and Orson Locke in Howling Fjord.
Forsaken Greatsword is sold by Initiate Claget in Icecrown and Orson Locke in Howling Fjord.
Forsaken Blightguards are Forsaken located in the Port of Zandalar in Dazar'alor. Some of them are mounted on skeletal horses.
Forsaken Blight Specialists are Forsaken located in Tiragarde Sound during Faction Assaults.
Forsaken Keenblades are Forsaken located in Windshorn Hills in Stormsong Valley.
The Forsaken Butcher is a Forsaken located in the Screaming Pit in Stormsong Valley. He is busy working on Alliance bodies.
The Formula: Enchanted Elethium Bar was sold by Archivist Janeera in Revendreth. It was removed, and the recipe is now taught by Imbuer Au'vresh in Oribos.
The Formula: Enchant Cloak - Superior Fire Resistance dropped from Skeletal Runesmiths at Malykriss: The Vile Hold of Icecrown.
Forsaken Bonechewers are skeletal hounds located on the Horde Airship in Drustvar during Faction Assault on Drustvar.
The Formidable Cloak can be obtained from Greater Bounty Spoils.
The Formidable Trinket can be obtained from Greater Bounty Spoils.
Formidable Jar of Doom is created with a Formidable Trinket.
Formidable Censer of Faith is created with a Formidable Trinket.
Formidable Orb of Putrescence is created with a Formidable Trinket.
